Resources • Vendor Licensing

Protect the Brand.
Build the Marketplace.

Sigma Gamma Rho's licensed vendor program governs authorized use of the Sorority's trademarks and supports a marketplace built around compliance, quality, and responsible stewardship of intellectual property.

Licensed Vendors

Verify before
you purchase.

The Official Licensed Vendor Directory is the primary source for confirming whether a business is authorized to sell products using Sigma Gamma Rho intellectual property. Reports involving non-delivery, poor quality, or vendor service concerns should be submitted through the official reporting process.

Vendor Program

Three licensing tiers.

New vendors begin in Tier 3 for their first licensing year. Licenses operate on a July 1–June 30 fiscal year and must be renewed annually.

Tier 1

Partners & Collaborators

$1,000

Annual advance fee

  • 0–22% royalties based on project scope
  • Quarterly reporting
  • Eligible for participation opportunities
Tier 2

Annual Sales Over $10,000

$2,400

Annual advance fee

  • 12% royalties
  • Quarterly reporting
  • Eligible for participation opportunities
Tier 3

Annual Sales Up to $10,000

$1,200

Annual advance fee

  • 0% royalties
  • Annual reporting
  • Generally not eligible for in-person participation

Application Windows

New applications
open once a year.

FY28January 1 – March 30, 2027
FY29January 1 – March 30, 2028
FY30January 1 – March 30, 2029

Applications are reviewed only during posted application windows. Tier 1 partner applications may be considered throughout the fiscal year.

Brand & Intellectual Property

Authorization carries
responsibility.

Licensees must comply with Sigma Gamma Rho's brand guidelines and submit mockups of licensed products for artwork review before launch. Upon acceptance, vendors must provide required payment and proof of insurance.
